label.about_me.title: About me
label.about_me.description:
For almost 5 years, I have been passionately developing mobile apps in Flutter, transforming complex business needs into simple and user-friendly solutions.

I have the pleasure of co-creating an application for one of the largest Polish energy companies. It is currently used by over 350,000 active users, and its 4.7 rating on the Google Play and App Stores is a source of pride for me.

A particularly satisfying project for me was an application for a global logistics company, which won the grand prize in the international competition "The Factory 2023", competing against over 20 teams from around the world. The key to success was the integration of native features of the Zebra terminal, such as a 3D scanner, with Flutter's capabilities.

A good knowledge of native iOS and Android technologies is fundamental to my effective work with Flutter. It allows me for deeper optimization and flexible project configuration, as well as working directly with native code, including the modernization of existing applications.

Before I fully dedicated myself to programming, as an acoustics engineer, I learned precision in analyzing technical documentation and the art of building valuable relationships with clients—skills I value to this day.

My portfolio is complemented by the completion of a dozen other, smaller applications of various types.

I invite you to explore selected projects in the "Projects" tab.
label.about_me.description_short_1: Nearly <bold>5 years of experience</bold> in developing mobile applications with Flutter (iOS, Android), along with hands-on knowledge of building backend structures in <bold>Firebase</bold> (Cloud Firestore, Realtime Database).
label.about_me.description_short_2: I co-develop the <bold>Moja Enea</bold> app — a solution trusted by over <bold>350,000 users</bold>, rated <bold>4.7/5.0</bold> on Google Play and the App Store. The app enables bill payments, energy purchases, e-invoice access, energy usage monitoring, convenient account management, customer support, and much more.
label.about_me.description_short_3: I am the author of an application for a global logistics company that won <bold>1st place</bold> in the international innovation competition <bold>“The Factory 2023”</bold>, surpassing over 20 teams from around the world.
label.about_me.description_short_4: I have extensive experience across the full software development lifecycle <bold>— from concept and implementation</bold> to <bold>maintenance and further development</bold>, with a strong focus on stability and scalability.
label.about_me.description_short_5: With experience in <bold>low-level programming</bold> (STM32) and <bold>electronics</bold>, I bridge the worlds of hardware and software, delivering <bold>innovative mobile and IoT projects</bold>. I create applications that are <bold>efficient, scalable, and secure</bold> — from proof-of-concept prototypes to solutions used by <bold>hundreds of thousands of users</bold>.
